description: a pale gaunt man necromancer with long black hair, a long black and purple robe with bone-white trim and a high collar, a staff topped with a ram skull in his right hand, a small green flame floating above his left hand held before his chest, seen from the side in strict profile: the face, chest, hips and feet all turned fully to the right, only one eye visible, never towards the viewer, facing and walking to the right, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look: face, hair, clothes, colours and what the hands hold
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen from the side, facing right, upright mid-step; copy it exactly
how a figure stands in this game's walks: fully in profile facing right, its size and its walking pose; draw the new character the same way
